```{r global_selection}
# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(lubridate)


# Input data
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/mbkro/OneDrive/Documents/wetland-ml-models/data/daily_wetlands_dataset.csv")

# Standardize WL and GWL variables within each site.
vars_to_scale <- c(
  "WL_daily_mean","WL_daily_max","WL_daily_min","WL_daily_range",
  "WL_mean_2day","WL_mean_3day","WL_mean_7day",
  "WL_max_2day","WL_max_3day","WL_max_7day",
  "WL_min_2day","WL_min_3day","WL_min_7day",
  "GWL_mean","GWL_max","GWL_min","GWL_range",
  "GWL_mean_2day","GWL_mean_3day","GWL_mean_7day",
  "GWL_max_2day","GWL_max_3day","GWL_max_7day",
  "GWL_min_2day","GWL_min_3day","GWL_min_7day"
)

vars_to_scale <- intersect(vars_to_scale, names(df))

# Return zero for nonmissing values when within-site variance is zero.
z_by_site <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(s) || s == 0) {
    return(ifelse(is.na(x), NA_real_, 0))
  }
  (x - m) / s
}

df_std <- df %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_to_scale), z_by_site)) %>%
  ungroup()


# Response variables and candidate predictors
responses <- c("mean_WT", "max_WT", "range_WT")

predictor_groups <- list(
  Solar    = c("Solar_daily", "Solar_2d", "Solar_3d", "Solar_7d"),
  WL_mean  = c("WL_daily_mean", "WL_mean_2day", "WL_mean_3day", "WL_mean_7day"),
  WL_max   = c("WL_daily_max", "WL_max_2day", "WL_max_3day", "WL_max_7day"),
  WL_min   = c("WL_daily_min", "WL_min_2day", "WL_min_3day", "WL_min_7day"),
  Air_tmean= c("Air_tmean", "Air_tmean_2day", "Air_tmean_3day", "Air_tmean_7day"),
  Air_tmax = c("Air_tmax", "Air_tmax_2day", "Air_tmax_3day", "Air_tmax_7day"),
  Air_tmin = c("Air_tmin", "Air_tmin_2day", "Air_tmin_3day", "Air_tmin_7day"),
  GWT_mean = c("GWT_mean", "GWT_mean_2day", "GWT_mean_3day", "GWT_mean_7day"),
  GWT_max  = c("GWT_max", "GWT_max_2day", "GWT_max_3day", "GWT_max_7day"),
  GWT_min  = c("GWT_min", "GWT_min_2day", "GWT_min_3day", "GWT_min_7day"),
  GWL_mean = c("GWL_mean", "GWL_mean_2day", "GWL_mean_3day", "GWL_mean_7day"),
  GWL_max  = c("GWL_max", "GWL_max_2day", "GWL_max_3day", "GWL_max_7day"),
  GWL_min  = c("GWL_min", "GWL_min_2day", "GWL_min_3day", "GWL_min_7day"),
  ppt      = c("ppt", "ppt_7day")
)

# Additional predictors retained in each global model
static_predictors <- c(
  "Air_trange", "WL_daily_range",
  "GWT_range", "GWL_range", "Water_area_m2_3d",
  "Elev_m", "Size_km2"
)


# Select temporal representations using GAMs and five week-blocked folds.

make_gam_weekly_folds <- function(data, k = 5, seed = 42) {
  weeks <- unique(lubridate::floor_date(as.Date(data$Datetime),
                                        unit = "week", week_start = 1))
  if (length(weeks) < k) stop("Not enough distinct weeks for GAM cross-validation")
  set.seed(seed)
  weeks <- sample(weeks)
  groups <- split(weeks, rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(weeks)))
  lapply(groups, function(w) {
    which(lubridate::floor_date(as.Date(data$Datetime),
                               unit = "week", week_start = 1) %in% w)
  })
}

select_gam_predictors <- function(train_data, response_var, k_folds = 5, seed = 42) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(predictor_groups, function(vars, group_name) {
    existing <- intersect(vars, names(train_data))
    if (!length(existing)) return(tibble())

    # Compare temporal alternatives using the same complete observations.
    common <- train_data %>%
      select(all_of(c("Datetime", response_var, existing))) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na()
    if (!nrow(common)) stop("No complete data for group: ", group_name)
    folds <- make_gam_weekly_folds(common, k = k_folds, seed = seed)

    scores <- purrr::map_dfr(existing, function(v) {
      pred <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(common))
      for (holdout in folds) {
        training <- common[-holdout, , drop = FALSE]
        # Use a linear term if there are fewer than five unique values.
        smooth_ok <- length(unique(training[[v]])) >= 5
        f <- if (smooth_ok) {
          stats::as.formula(paste0(response_var, " ~ s(`", v, "`, k = 5)"))
        } else {
          stats::reformulate(v, response = response_var)
        }
        fit <- mgcv::gam(f, data = training, method = "REML")
        pred[holdout] <- stats::predict(fit, newdata = common[holdout, , drop = FALSE])
      }
      tibble(predictor = v, cv_rmse = sqrt(mean((common[[response_var]] - pred)^2)))
    })
    scores %>%
      arrange(cv_rmse, match(predictor, existing)) %>%
      slice(1) %>%
      mutate(group = group_name, n = nrow(common), .before = 1)
  })
}

# Full-data selections are for final datasets; model CV selects within training folds.
best_predictors_all <- purrr::map(responses, ~ select_gam_predictors(df_std, .x))
names(best_predictors_all) <- responses

combined_predictor_lists <- purrr::map(best_predictors_all,
                                      ~ unique(c(.x$predictor, static_predictors)))

model_data <- purrr::map2(combined_predictor_lists, responses, function(vars, response) {
  df_std %>% select(any_of(c("Site", "Datetime", response, vars)))
})
names(model_data) <- responses

mean_model_final  <- model_data[["mean_WT"]]
max_model_final   <- model_data[["max_WT"]]
range_model_final <- model_data[["range_WT"]]


output_dir <- "C:/Users/mbkro/OneDrive/Documents/wetland-ml-models/data"
write.csv(mean_model_final,  file.path(output_dir, "mean_global_data_revised.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(max_model_final,   file.path(output_dir, "max_global_data_revised.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(range_model_final, file.path(output_dir, "range_global_data_revised.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

selection_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(best_predictors_all,
                                    ~ mutate(.x, response = .y, .before = 1))
write.csv(selection_summary,
          file.path(output_dir, "global_gam_selection_revised.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(selection_summary)

```

## Site summary

```{r site_summary}
# Means and standard deviations by site
site_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meanWT   = mean(mean_WT, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_meanWT     = sd(mean_WT, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_maxWT    = mean(max_WT, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_maxWT      = sd(max_WT, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_minWT    = mean(min_WT, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_minWT      = sd(min_WT, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rangeWT  = mean(range_WT, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rangeWT    = sd(range_WT, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(site_summary)

write.csv(site_summary, file.path(output_dir, "site_summary_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Fold selection frequencies

```{r global_outer_fold_frequency}
# Uses selections exported by the global modeling script.

selection_path <- file.path(
  "C:/Users/mbkro/OneDrive/Documents/wetland-ml-models",
  "results", "global_gam_selection_folds_revised.csv"
)

stopifnot(file.exists(selection_path))

fold_sel <- readr::read_csv(selection_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Deduplicate recorded selections within each model and fold.
fold_sel <- fold_sel %>%
  dplyr::distinct(model_id, fold, group, predictor)

print(unique(fold_sel$model_id))

global_frequency <- fold_sel %>%
  dplyr::count(model_id, group, predictor, name = "n_selected") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(model_id, group, dplyr::desc(n_selected))

print(global_frequency, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  global_frequency,
  file.path(dirname(selection_path),
            "supp_global_temporal_selection_frequency.csv")
)
```
